journeys.name: Tender: create from a purchase request, send, publish, advert and corrigendum
journeys.objective: A need approved in Procurement is put out to tender, with its close date and its announcements.
journeys.userRole: Sourcing officer (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the sourcing right. One branch is chosen in the header. A tender category. An approved purchase request in Procurement and its internal id (09-procurement.xlsx).
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Sourcing and clicks Tenders in the menu
2. Clicks "Create tender"
3. Types the number, the category in "Code" and the type open in "Name", clicks "Next", pastes the id of the purchase request into "Document", types the close date in "Close" and clicks "Save"

Nothing was saved.

journeys.name: Bids: record, submit, open, evaluate and accept
journeys.objective: The offers of the bidders are taken in, opened after the close date, graded, compared, and one is accepted.
journeys.userRole: Sourcing officer, Evaluation committee (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the sourcing right. One branch is chosen in the header. A published tender and its id. Two bidders.
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Sourcing and clicks Bids in the menu
2. Clicks "Bid"
3. Pastes the tender id into "Document", types the bidder in "Code" and the price and clicks "Save"; repeats for the second bidder
4. For each bid, pastes the id of the bid into "Document" and saves "Submit bid", then "Open bid"
5. Types the grade in "Name" and saves "Evaluate accept" for the first bid; types a reason in "Note" and saves "Evaluate reject" for the second
6. Pastes the tender id, types the bidder in "Code" and accepted in "Name" and saves "Sheet"; repeats with rejected for the second bidder
7. After the close date, pastes the id of the first bid and saves "Accept bid"
journeys.expectedOutcome: States of a bid: draft, submitted, opened, accepted. A bid is accepted only after the close date of its tender.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/sourcing/bids opened (HTTP 200, title "Bids"). journeys.name: One tender from the purchase request to the agreement
journeys.objective: A need raised in Procurement is tendered, awarded and contracted, and every application involved shows its part.
journeys.userRole: Purchasing officer, Sourcing officer, Budget officer, Accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the sourcing right. One branch is chosen in the header. The masters of the journeys above.
journeys.steps:
1. Purchasing officer approves a purchase request in Procurement
2. Sourcing officer creates, sends and publishes the tender from it
3. Records, submits and opens two bids and takes the fee and the deposit of each bidder
4. Evaluates, fills the sheet and, after the close date, accepts the better bid
5. Creates, sends and approves the agreement and saves the sanction
6. Refunds the deposit of the loser and converts the winner to a supplier
7. Purchasing officer looks at the purchase request and makes the purchase order
journeys.expectedOutcome: TBD with the product owner: how Procurement learns the result of a tender.
